subject: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stellarsys.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Jordan Matthews <j.matthews@stellarsys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval

Hi Alex / Maria —

Great speaking with you this morning. Per our discovery call, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the StellarSys POC + pilot. High level recap and proposed milestones below — please review and confirm edits so we can lock dates and route for internal approvals.

Post-call recap / goals:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for enterprise search & summarization across StellarSys knowledge base (POC)
- Success metrics: <=200ms 95th percentile latency; cost target $0.002/token effective with batch/caching profile; accuracy threshold per eval set (we'll share prompt set)

Draft MAP (high level):
1) POC kickoff (Redwood + StellarSys integration) — owner: StellarSys dev lead (Jordan); target: 2026-03-23
2) Security & compliance review (SOC 2 evidence + network diagram) — owner: StellarSys InfoSec (Maria) / Redwood security (Marissa) — target: 2026-03-30
3) Pilot evaluation (2 weeks) — owner: StellarSys product — target: 2026-04-13
4) Procurement & contract finalization — owner: StellarSys procurement / Redwood sales & legal — target: 2026-04-20
5) Production rollout decision / reserved capacity commit — owner: StellarSys execs / Redwood sales — target close date: 2026-04-30

Dependencies / asks:
- Procurement timeline & legal contact for contract redlines
- Clarify expected commit level (monthly vs annual reserved capacity) and target budget range
- Exec review for pricing approvals if discounts/credits required

Attachments: StellarSys_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes milestone dates, responsibilities, and proposed pricing scenarios (on tab 'Pricing Scenarios').

Next steps:
- Please review the MAP draft and reply with any date/owner adjustments by EOD Thu 3/12
- Alex: confirm procurement lead and expected commit level (term & budget)
- Maria: confirm InfoSec checklist items you want us to prioritize

Note on pricing approvals: per Redwood policy, discounts >20% or credit concessions >$10k require pricing lead sign-off and may need VP approval. If you expect to request >20% discount or >$10k pilot credits, flag here and I'll route to my pricing/ops leader.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@stellarsys.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A couple quick notes:
- Can we shift POC kickoff to 2026-03-30 (we have a product freeze the week of 3/23)
- Security review target of 3/30 looks good but Maria will confirm specifics
- Procurement: I will introduce our procurement lead (Maria) — our budget team is aligned to a pilot spend of ~$25k and we are aiming for an annual reserved commit if the pilot meets goals.

On pricing — for us to commit to a reserved 12-month contract we will need some pilot credits for ROI proof and a commercial discount. Would Redwood be open to 25% off list for year-one + $15k pilot credits (applied to first month)? If needed I can escalate to our CFO but wanted to understand your constraints.

Alex
Head of Product, StellarSys
alex.chen@stellarsys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval — pricing ask (25% + $15k credits)

Rishi / Dev —

Forwarding StellarSys' MAP + pricing ask. Key points:
- Deal: StellarSys (DEAL-7842) — pilot budget ~$25k, intent to commit to 12-month reserved capacity if pilot succeeds
- External request: 25% discount year-one + $15k pilot credits
- Redwood ask: need pricing approval (discount) and confirmation of credit concession authority. Also flagging potential need for VP approval given >20% discount and credits >$10k.

Attachments: StellarSys_MAP_v1.xlsx, StellarSys_SOW_draft.docx

Could you advise:
1) Approve 25% discount + $15k credits under the condition of 12-month commit?
2) If not, what is the max discount/credit we can offer without VP review?

Happy to add any detail you need (forecast ARR, TAM notes). Also marking map for exec review next week if necessary.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval — pricing ask (25% + $15k credits)

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Quick guidance:
- Director-level (me) is authorized to approve up to 20% discount for new logo pilot->commit deals. Anything >20% requires VP approval (vp_pricing@redwood.ai).
- Credit concessions: we can approve up to $10k in pilot credits with sales director sign-off. >$10k requires Finance/Rev Ops sign-off and VP approval depending on deal economics.

Proposal: Offer 20% year-one discount + $10k pilot credits conditioned on a 12-month reserved capacity commit at the proposed pricing band. If StellarSys insists on 25%/15k credits, I'll escalate to VP with our recommendation and deal economics (please provide estimated ARR and margin impact).

Also please update the MAP with the adjusted kickoff date (3/30) and add the procurement contact details. I'll need a short one-page commercial summary for VP review if we escalate.

Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval — legal / procurement note

Marissa / Rishi —

A couple legal/procurement notes from preliminary review of the SOW draft:
- We should confirm StellarSys' standard PO terms and whether they require any deviations to our standard Redwood MSA. If they require indemnity changes or data residency clauses, that will add review time (estimate 2-3 business days).
- For pilot credits: ensure credits are time-boxed to the pilot window and laid out in the SOW.
- Procurement: if StellarSys requires a PO for pilot spend, provide a simplified purchase order template to speed routing.

I'll standby to review final SOW redlines — please loop in legal@redwood.ai for formal sign-off if we move to contract.

Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@stellarsys.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@stellarsys.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: StellarSys MAP draft & pricing approval

Alex / Maria —

Thanks for the quick responses and for flagging procurement details. Short summary & next steps:
- Updated kickoff: 2026-03-30 (Mar 30) — I'll update the MAP and send v2
- Pricing: Rishi can approve up to 20% + $10k credits under director sign-off. We are preparing a one-page commercial summary for VP escalation if StellarSys still prefers 25% / $15k credits.
- Legal: Dev flagged PO and SOW redline timings — Maria, please let us know if your procurement team needs a PO template and the expected PO approval lead time.
- Proposed next step: schedule an exec review (15–30 min) the week of 3/16 to decide on escalation. What times work for your execs?

I'll update MAP (v2) with the new kickoff date and owners and re-share the SOW template.

Best —
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
